capturePerformance.scope: One-frame diagnostic readback; not interactive frame timing

limitations: Local normalized correlation on native pixels, sampled on a grid; not a human perceptual model.
Alternate matches include inherent harmonic repetitions; they are candidates, not proof of perceived ghost layers.

fidelity.scope: RGB error versus aligned original render; not a perceptual fusion score

findings.message: Large areas lack consistent, distinctive matching evidence. Inspect the unsupported-region map.
Strong nonharmonic matches exist outside the calibrated depth range.

observer.scope: Image-only, linear-luminance multiscale correlation and chromaticity disagreement. Engineering thresholds are not calibrated human comfort probabilities.

limits: Central decoding is not human fusion confirmation.
CSS surround is excluded from decoded stereo pixels.
Fullscreen and pointer lock were not reverified.
